crossRefs.note: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,
translations.bsb: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. As he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came to him:
translations.kjv: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
translations.asv: And when Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold, there came a voice of the Lord,
